verdict.rationale: Hardware media engines are a fair axis for a desktop processor, and the Ryzen Master docs mention integrated Radeon graphics, but nothing in the pack documents on-chip AV1, HEVC or ProRes-class encode or decode. The creator-oriented marketing (color grading, DaVinci Resolve) refers to general CPU processing power, not dedicated media engines, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a creator, hardware media engines carry my editing and streaming — documented hardware encode and decode (AV1, HEVC, ProRes-class) on the chip itself
